_about: Discovery two-option component (founder approval, 2 Nov 2026: Living in the Garden pilot). Two ways to explore ONE Discovery: explore the makers and products yourself, or enter that Discovery's EXISTING guided Journey. Rendered by atlas-tools/build-supplier-gallery.py beneath the gallery heading and figures, above the carousel, only for Discoveries listed here. A Discovery may be listed only when it has BOTH a supplier gallery / Maker Explorer AND an existing guided Journey with Atlas-matched results (see the 2 Nov 2026 Discovery audit). No new Journey, matching, intake or form. Guarded by atlas-tools/prove-discovery-two-option.py.

discovery-living-in-the-garden.html.why: DISC-008 Phase 2 (founder approval of the six-chapter redesign, 3 Nov 2026): the gallery's two-option card and the page's duplicate Journey panels were consolidated into ONE decision, the page's closing panel (chapter 06), which carries both routes: A Explore yourself and B Let PlotNua do the homework. explore.label: Explore yourself
explore.text: Explore garden rooms and garden homes from a wide range of makers. Browse products, compare what’s available and visit suppliers directly.

homework.label: Let PlotNua do the homework
homework.text: Tell us what you’re looking for. We’ll use our Atlas research to help you find options that match your preferences and budget.
